notes: The author's answer rules out the roleplay-only reading and names a guard-versus-prisoner loop with escapes and weapons, so this leads with Survival — asymmetric roles contained in one place, won by getting out — and names Shooter second because the weapons are explicit and only its collectible-loot expresses an armoury and a criminal weapon cache players arm themselves from. Shape is space-bounded, Survival's Contained Arena, because the whole map is the compound plus the small strip of outside the author asked for; warren-looping was rejected despite being the preset's shape since its zero-dead-ends P6 exists to stop pathfinding AI cornering a fleeing player and the pursuers here are other players, while cells and corridors are meant to dead-end, and interior-single is ruled out by the outside area. Kept the Escape preset with that shape substituted, so the route is P0 from the shape rather than its P6, and added spawn-protected so guards, prisoners and escapees do not start on top of each other. Decided without a user that the perimeter wall gate is the escape trigger and that cover reads as yard obstacles breaking guard-tower sightlines rather than horror crawlspaces; P3 is genuine and unavoidable because breaking out of cell blocks, cafeteria and armoury into the yard is the game itself.
